hyperedges.label: Topic Progress Tracking System
hyperedges.description: Completion state flows from data-complete-toggle attribute on topic pages -> ProgressManager.toggle(id) -> localStorage 'ai102_progress' -> ProgressManager.getPartProgress() reads PARTS_META.topicIds -> renders progress bars on part index pages. TOPIC_REGISTRY provides id-to-part mapping.

hyperedges.label: Sidebar Injection and Navigation Flow
hyperedges.description: On DOMContentLoaded: _ai102Prefixes() scans script tags to find config.js (course root) and common.js (hub root) -> computes relative prefix paths -> SidebarTemplate(p) generates full nav HTML using TOPIC_REGISTRY -> injects into #app-sidebar -> _highlightActive() marks current page. config.js presence as a script tag is the sole mechanism for depth detection.
